evidence.note: Dozens of ~1 px light-grey spoke lines run from small agent-run dots to the Package mirror node; the dots themselves are small thin-outlined circles.
At the small window the spokes become near-invisible hairlines and the agent dots shrink to a few pixels; the 'Package mirror' label is half-covered by faint document icons.
'PUBLIC INTERNET' label is small, pale grey on paper background, barely legible; the globe icon and arrow are thin pale strokes.
Title, timeline text and callout cards are large with good contrast; background is flat paper colour with no grain.
Insight card text is generous and high-contrast; the blurred backdrop is intentional de-emphasis.

rationale: Text blocks and cards are generous and the paper feel comes from colour, not texture. However, the central diagram is built from many 1 px pale-grey spoke lines and tiny thin-outlined dots, which matches the fail anchor of thin grey lines that compression erases. The faint small 'PUBLIC INTERNET' label at 1288x598 adds small low-contrast text.
